comparison.objective: Establish double-block-and-bleed isolation before cap removal, versus adjust a de-energized damper and prove its setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve sequencing, bleed operation, and cap removal versus recessed tool use, collar rotation, relocking, and guarded dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Both block valves closed, bleed open, indicator off, then cap removed versus two compliant carriage stops with no unsafe impact or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both enforce de-energized safe maintenance, but the tested manipulation and endpoint are materially different. No spec versions are present; the body provides no valve-angle, pressure, or cap-removal tolerances.
